Double-sided faces held by their planes in the scene field, read on the engine's tree against
`2ad96a80` on an RTX 4070 Laptop GPU under tuned's `powersave-bazzite`, in item 89's wheat room,
eight by eight blocks of four double-sided walls a block tall half a unit apart under the game's sun
at ten, at High at 800 by 450 against path-traced references of 256 paths a pixel, and in a closed
room of double-sided sheets six units across under a sky of one blue.

The band a double-sided face was held below zero within, swept as half a cell times a factor, the
walls against the reference, those facing the eye and the sun and those seen from their backs:

| half a cell | +44.0% | +44.6% | +13.8% | +7.7% | met by a ray |
| 0.4 of a cell | +37.7% | +37.4% | +17.6% | +11.2% | passed by a ray |

| the plane a cell, kept | -1.9% | -5.1% | -8.3% | -10.4% | met by a ray |

A march meets a surface under a tenth of a cell and the blend of the cells' middles holds a sheet
lying midway between them no nearer than half a cell, so held within less than 0.4 of a cell a sheet
there is passed. The plane a cell keeps is met exactly from either side. Held a tenth of a cell
either side the march, stepping a quarter of a cell at least, stepped over it, a CPU march of the
field from inside the closed room passing the walls by 22 rays of 400, and by 3 held a quarter.

| the plane, held a quarter, the probes moved off along the plane's way | 0.054 | 0.013 |

On the cells' grid a world probe stands on a sheet, where the field's gradient cancels across it.
Shifted off the grid by 0.37 the room reads 0.004 at Low where 0.019.

In the voxel game's cherry grove at High at 1920 by 1080, read by turns with no other program on the
GPU, global illumination took 5.27 to 5.28 ms before. Reading the plane in every reader of the field
took it to 8.06 to 8.10 ms, and to 6.65 with the plane read only where the cells around keep one,
the scene pass from 7.1 to 8.5 ms, the same whether the plane's branch was taken or not, and to 5.95
ms and 8.46 kept as a branch the compiler keeps; the frames differed by 0.08 of 255 on the mean.
Read by the probes' rays alone, with every other reader holding a sheet half a cell either side from
the planes the cells around keep, global illumination took 5.64 ms and the scene pass 7.19 to 7.21
where 7.17 to 7.43. The four half floats a cell where one cost 0.2 ms of it.

Where two walls cross on a cell's edge the four cells about it lie as near both and keep one plane,
so the other wall was held there by the cells' blend alone, and the world's probes put dark round
patches at the walls' feet where they cross, sharper and more of them than the one soft spot the
band left. The second commit keeps a second plane where another double-sided face of another way
passes within three quarters of a cell of a cell's middle, in an image of its own the probes' rays
read beside the field, and a point beside either sheet in the cells about a crossing is met where
the first plane alone left one 0.095 off. The walls against the reference, and the pixels of the
picture's lower half under 0.6 of the reference's light:

| held half a cell either side | +44.0%, +44.6% | +13.5%, +18.1% | 0 | 994 |

The patches beside the crossing nearest the eye went softer and the one at it stands, at Low too,
where the world's probes read alone, and with global illumination off none does; shifted off the
cells' grid by 0.37 no round patch showed, though the walls the view takes in moved with it, so a
world probe standing on both sheets of a crossing on the grid is where it is read next. The closed
room of sheets took 0.048 of the sky's light at Low and 0.0085 at High where 0.054 and 0.013, and
